name: Hoi An food guide
summary: Hoi An’s signature bowl is cao lau. Add a banh mi, white rose dumplings, and com ga if you have a second day.
body: Eat cao lau at a shop that makes it the center of the menu. The noodles should be chewy and the broth scarce.
Cooking classes are the bookable activity here. Pick one that shops at the market in the morning rather than one that only assembles pre-cut trays.
seoDescription: What to eat in Hoi An, starting with cao lau.
